Scope: diagnostic copy only; no production or original test changes. Raw `ci-debcb-recovery-win24.log` records run39708997860/job119595570838: seven files93 =92P1F; runtime case1 failed after2619ms at its final root rm with EPERM, case2 real KSwarm reopen passed. This does not identify the held Windows handle or prove all business assertions passed.

Additional actual Windows22.22 job119595571290 raw `ci-debcb-recovery-win22-22.log` SHA256 `705c027e73fafcd31eee846059a8169492ed92abbb085ba7959e60b88cb7b67c`: case1 EBUSY unlink explicitly names data/artifact-workspace/workspace.sqlite; seven93=92P1F, case2 real reopen passes. This directly connects the unclosed artifact store path to a real Windows failure, rather than only a generic root inference. Other possible unclosed owners must still be inventoried and closed, not masked by fixing just this first failing path.

Read chain: handoff returns after scoped Host retirement; runner closes model physical scope; write uses synchronous write/rename. No process.chdir found in the read chain. createDesktopServices always creates Goal and ArtifactWorkspace SQLite stores, while disposeMultiAgent does not close them. Runner notebook registration also gets the process memory singleton, whose layered backend has a separate close. Goal exposes a real drain-protected durable close. The artifact store has a real close on its private actual instance. Therefore multi-agent disposal alone is not an entire app shutdown receipt.

First independently inventory the app shutdown graph and every always/lazy store under this owned dataRoot. Then create one exact temporary test copy, preserving the original two cases, assertions,20s budget, HTTP/model/tool behavior. Run only original case1 by exact test-name filter, maxWorkers1, without CPU profiling. It is diagnostic1, never full2/93 evidence.

Use passive constructor observation for actual Goal/ArtifactWorkspace stores: call original constructors once with all original arguments and return the very same actual instances; do not substitute store/SQL/authority behavior. A pass-through DatabaseSync.exec observer records actual receiver identity only (no SQL text), exposing other native instances for the inventory. Observe actual native DB own isOpen getter and store kind, not query/payload contents. Observe the already-created memory singleton/backend without opening a replacement. After original dispose/server close, log native open state, current cwd relative to owned root and remaining relative entry types. The only diagnostic safety interlock is the exact owned-root rm leaf: if a captured actual owner is open or its state is unknown, throw an explicit diagnostic error before the destructive rm and retain the journal. This is a failed diagnostic, not test success or an EPERM fix. If every captured owner is confirmed closed, delegate the original strict rm unchanged. No retries or swallowed EPERM.

Safety exception in the copy: explicitly pass knowledgeDbPath=join(owned root,'knowledge.sqlite'), because the original omits this option and createDesktopServices:1129-1133 otherwise opens the real OS account's default KB outside dataRoot. This uses the original real KB implementation, not a mock; it does not change any original predicate/model/tool step. The diagnostic must never touch that shared default KB. Record this difference openly; it belongs in the permanent fixture design too. Actual KB is accessible through services.getKnowledgeBaseStore(); capture its native state without initiating a new owner. This different assembly cannot exclude the old shared-default KB as an additional factor in the old Windows failure.

Inventory read: Goal/ArtifactWorkspace/native Codex route+native stores/optional MultiAgent/KB/optional Activity+lazy memory are SQLite owners. ConversationRoom/ConversationProject/Connectors/bootstrap/snapshot/material/artifact files are JSON/file sources, not SQLite. MultiAgent disposal owns Codex and its own guarded store plus Activity source watchers/store, but not Goal/ArtifactWorkspace/memory/KB. Existing app main:839-840 registers Goal ingress/durable;853-854 registers separate local-memory and multi-agent cleanup. Other app-only Loop/timed-action stores are constructed in main, not in this fixture. Task source and material/artifact writers expose separate real seal/drain APIs. This inventory does not assert that every owner was opened in this case; the passive actual receiver set will record that fact.

All allocation/setup is inside try; register cleanup before each subsequent await. Independent cleanup attempts preserve body plus cleanup errors, restore every spy/env, and do not force-close unknown owners. Any open/unknown owner, cwd inside the root, or incomplete resource inventory blocks root deletion on every OS and records failed forensic retention, never partial recursive removal. Only a complete confirmed-closed inventory with cwd/resource exclusion can reach the original strict rm. Retain that exact root with creation canonical/stat/pid/ppid/run identity and report it; only the owned parent after actual worker reap, PGID0/worker0 and exact canonical/dev/ino/uid/birthtime match may remove it. No generic tmp sweep, no shared process signals. The original CI EPERM remains the actual failure evidence; the protected diagnostic deliberately does not reproduce destructive cleanup byte-for-byte.

Archive exact diagnostic copy and SHA, then remove only that copy after own process group exits and restore original test file population. No second diagnostic or wider CPU run automatically follows a timeout. A/B/root review precedes this diagnostic. Permanent fixture design follows actual evidence and gets its own review/red regression: original owner drains then real store closes, strict root removal only with close confirmation; unknown/held journals remain failed forensic retention. e=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

positive=lambda v:isinstance(v,int) and not isinstance(v,bool) and v>0
assert meta['reaped'] is True and isinstance(meta['exitCode'],int)
assert all(positive(meta[k]) for k in ['pid','pgid','runnerPid'])
started=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(meta['startedAt']).timestamp()*1000
finished=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(meta['finishedAt']).timestamp()*1000
assert math.isfinite(started) and math.isfinite(finished) and started<=finished
assert isinstance(meta['activityForensicsRunToken'],str) and len(meta['activityForensicsRunToken'])==32
ps=subprocess.check_output(['ps','-axo','pid=,ppid=,pgid=,command='],text=True)
rows=[line.split(None,3) for line in ps.splitlines() if len(line.split(None,3))==4]
assert not [r for r in rows if int(r[0])==meta['pid'] or int(r[2])==meta['pgid']]
records=[]
for line in (e/(label+'.log')).read_text().splitlines():
 if line.startswith('XIAOK_PROJECT_RUNTIME_RETAINED_ROOT '):records.append(json.loads(line.split(' ',1)[1]))
seen=set();results=[]

 assert positive(r['workerPid']) and positive(r['workerPpid'])

 assert not [x for x in rows if int(x[0])==r['workerPid']]
 root=Path(r['root']);assert str(root) not in seen;seen.add(str(root))
 assert root.parent==Path(tempfile.gettempdir()).resolve() and root.name.startswith('project-model-runtime-')
 assert not root.is_symlink() and root.resolve()==root and root.is_dir()
 stat=root.lstat();expected=r['stat']
 assert all(isinstance(expected[k],int) and not isinstance(expected[k],bool) and expected[k]>=0 for k in ['dev','ino','uid'])
 birth=expected['birthtimeMs'];assert isinstance(birth,(int,float)) and math.isfinite(birth) and started-2000<=birth<=finished+2000
 assert stat.st_dev==expected['dev'] and stat.st_ino==expected['ino'] and stat.st_uid==expected['uid']==os.getuid()==r['uid']
 assert math.isclose(stat.st_birthtime*1000,birth,abs_tol=.01)
 shutil.rmtree(root);assert not root.exists();results.append({'root':str(root),'workerPid':r['workerPid'],'identityMatched':True,'deletedAfterWorkerAndGroupExit':True})
out={'label':label,'runnerReaped':True,'pid':meta['pid'],'pgid':meta['pgid'],'groupMembers':[],'signalsSent':0,'records':results,'deleted':len(results)}

# Windows runtime 生命周期终稿独立模型审查

**结论：APPROVE。** 本席是协作工具明确路由的 `gpt-5.6-sol`，与主笔 GPT-6 不同；本次只读审查最终 test SHA256 `15b86ff5265e0831b123640c3daa9e208402dffc5c7faf89dc476c92c350f712`、helper SHA256 `fb8d90d2d0da125ddfe4d58462808ee368546419ff8c362b9004111d3675d39e`，对应主 HEAD `713db33e6c8d6f1897505252aab1a57c688581eb`。无必改项。本票不复用旧 GLM、旧 7c 绿票或其结论。

## 独立攻击结论

- `withProjectModelRuntimeLifetime` 在 helper 第 20–37 行只建立一个 scenario Promise；`onTestFinished` 等待同一 `settledOutcome`。ctx 超时/取消后，若 scenario 的独立原错误既不是 `ctx.signal.reason`、也不是完成全部验收后登记的同一 `accepted.error`，hook 会重抛。指定负例若未真正 reject，第 36 行以 `project_runtime_fixture_expected_rejection_missing` 失败。
- 第 172–177 行按逆序逐个 `attempt` 全部 action，再逐个恢复全部 spy；单一业务错误保持原对象，业务与清理并存时以业务原对象为首项。server close 等待真实 callback 并保留 callback error。
- 第 93–127 行先独立尝试 Goal ingress、原 `disposeMultiAgent`、task-source population、material/artifact-file manager、artifact service 与 Goal drain。任一项失败都会在第 103 行返回，Goal/Artifact/KB/memory 均不会被强关。所有 drain 成功后，第 104 行才检查实际 coordinator `active===0` 与实际 multi-agent runtime `blocked===false`；检查失败直接退出 durable 阶段。
- held negative 使用真实 `DesktopExecutionCoordinator.acquireLease({policy:'ordinary'})`。原 `disposeMultiAgent` 可以 fulfilled，但 active 仍为 1；第 133–150、222–240 行要求本次 physical/root 原错误完整有序，且实际 Goal、Artifact、KB 的同 receiver native getter 仍为 true、真实 memory DB 仍 open、root 仍存在，然后才释放 lease。它封住了“dispose fulfilled 就有权关 journal”的旧漏洞。
- 第 55–73 行的 `DatabaseSync.prototype.exec` spy 调用捕获的原函数并返回原结果，只记录真实 receiver；Artifact/Goal spy 用捕获的 production class 和全部原参数做 `Reflect.construct`，返回原始实例，没有 SQL/Store mock。删除前第 160–163 行重新以捕获的 own non-configurable `isOpen` getter和同一 receiver读取全部记录；任何 getter 缺失、非布尔或仍 true 都保留 root 并失败。最终转引的两版原始日志均报告 `nativeReceivers:8`、八项 false、memory false。
- memory 取自 `createDesktopServices` 已完成且默认 runner 已注册 notebook 后的同 dataRoot singleton。第 109–127 行调用真实 close、验证幂等 close，再切换到 owned root 下另一 dataRoot，要求不同真实 store、原生后端时 open，最后两次 close 并验证 false；纯 JS fallback 不伪造 native DB。
- partial/held/unknown 三组负例没有用字符串或子集匹配。`assertExactKnownFailureTree`（第 243–254 行）核 Aggregate brand、完整人口、顺序、每个原 Error 引用、叶子非 Aggregate 且无自有 `cause/errors`、根无自有 cause。unknown wrapper 另核恰好两个 child、实际 validator 引用与 `cause===inner`。额外 V 会把 inner 从四项变五项，验收必须 reject；第 217 行再以 `[原 failure, 新验证错误]` 保存，因此 V 仍从最终树可达。
- root 删除门在第 152–170 行要求 services 已登记、原 dispose fulfilled、无 cleanup error、再次物理 quiescent、Goal/Artifact 各恰一实例、native receipt 非空、全部记录 false、memory false（若有 native DB）、cwd 在 root 外。任一未知/持有/失败均打印包含 canonical root、PID/PPID、uid、run token、dev/ino/birthtime 的 forensic identity 并拒绝删除。

## 已核真实 production 入口

当前 worktree production 文件未变化；以下是本席逐行读取的真实入口，不以 mock 或设计文档代替：

- `desktop/electron/desktop-services.ts` SHA256 `a943a496…`：第 319–399 行是 memory singleton；1005–1024 行构造 coordinator、Goal 与 Artifact；1127–1141 行按显式 `knowledgeDbPath` 构造 KB；1869–1909 行把真实默认 runner 接进 coordinator；2157–2195 行先经 task-source admission 再协调 scoped runner；2885–2928 行是真实三个 drain 与 `disposeMultiAgent`；4080–4083 行是真实 KB accessor。
- `desktop/electron/desktop-execution-coordinator.ts` SHA256 `a5136634…`：第 92–123、158–219、226–252 行是实际 lease 入队、active 增减和 release。
- `desktop/electron/desktop-multi-agent-service.ts` SHA256 `7864a5eb…`：第 3202–3269 行是 dispose、物理资源收束及失败时设置 runtime/coordinator blocked。
- `desktop/electron/desktop-goal-shutdown-owner.ts` SHA256 `1c578987…`：第 15–18 行在 Goal store close 前再次要求 `drain(0)`。
- `desktop/electron/artifact-workspace-store.ts` SHA256 `6a678a0e…` 第 205–233 行、`goal-store-sqlite.ts` SHA256 `a6396a9b…` 第 45–70 行、`kb-store-sqlite.ts` SHA256 `b802def6…` 第 140–150、687–698 行均是实际 `node:sqlite` 构造与 close；`src/ai/memory/layered-store.ts` SHA256 `275613bb…` 第 94–117、404–413 行是真实 better-sqlite3 store、closed guard 与 DB close。
- `desktop/electron/main.ts` SHA256 `f25ac6d…` 第 839–854 行分别登记 Goal ingress/durable、memory 与 multi-agent app owner，证实 `disposeMultiAgent` 不是整个 App 的 store shutdown。

## 范围保持与转引验证

`git diff` 显示没有 production 改动；变更限原 test、未跟踪的新 helper 与设计。转引的 source audit 记录：仍是原 2 cases、原 7 个 expect 表达式及顺序、第一例 20 秒、第二例/default hook 预算不变，第二例 bytes 不变，KSwarm 仍通过真实 source reopen。
